benchmarks.channel_style: Vox - Editorial Mixed-Media Explainer & Archival Broadsheets

hook_metrics_00_to_45s.opening_hook_mechanic: Visual paradox contrast followed by primary-source highlight sweep and direct thesis question within 12 seconds.

layer_composition.background: Desaturated 0.85x slow-motion planetary/archival plate graded at -22% saturation
layer_composition.midground_animation: Subtle floating atmospheric dust motes and soft vignette
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Bottom-left Cinzel + Courier Prime location/date stamp with 0.4s left-to-right mask reveal

audio_sync.music_state: Low atmospheric drone entering at -23 dB, auto-ducked to -28 dB under voice

layer_composition.background: Realistic archival photograph dimmed to 65% brightness
layer_composition.midground_animation: Animated dashed vector callout lines, target reticles, and timeline/bar breakdown in #EAB308 and #D9381E
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Selective emphasis Courier Prime keyword stamp on key numbers

audio_sync.music_state: Minimalist investigative pulse under speech (-28 dB)

layer_composition.background: Dark archival grid surface with 15px blurred B-roll at 40% opacity
layer_composition.midground_animation: Floating archival broadsheet clipping sliding in at -1.5 deg rotation
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Multiply #FFD700 brush-stroke highlighter wiping synced to key phrase

timeline_breakdown.camera_motion: Slight horizontal pan following highlighter sweep

reproducible_style_rules: Dim realistic photographic plates to 65% before drawing 2D schematic vectors so #EAB308/#D9381E callouts stay razor-sharp.
Pair every archival newspaper highlight wipe with an organic felt-tip brush SFX (-12 dB).
Trigger selective-emphasis captions strictly on dates, quantities, and decisive historical verbs.

benchmarks.channel_style: Johnny Harris - Cartographic Maps, Tactile Pins & Floating PiP

hook_metrics_00_to_45s.opening_hook_mechanic: Geographic mystery anchor with zooming tactical route arc connecting two distinct historical cities.

layer_composition.background: Dark tactile parchment/slate cartographic map with subtle topographic contour lines
layer_composition.midground_animation: Glowing Bezier migration arc launching from Origin City A to Destination City B with radar ping rings
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Coordinate telemetry header and Courier Prime location labels

timeline_breakdown.camera_motion: Smooth virtual camera pan and zoom tracking arc tip from origin to destination

audio_sync.music_state: Low cello ostinato + brushed pulse at -28 dB under voice

layer_composition.background: Blurred slow-motion atmospheric B-roll (15px blur, 40% opacity)
layer_composition.midground_animation: 1 to 3 floating PiP archival evidence frames (scale 55%-75%, 2px translucent border, deep drop shadow)
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Date/location lower-left stamp + crimson pin connectors

timeline_breakdown.camera_motion: Counter-drifting cards with +/-1.8 deg spring tilt

reproducible_style_rules: Use cartographic route animations ONLY when origin and destination are genuinely distinct historical geographies.
Never obscure map labels with PiP windows; anchor PiP windows cleanly into opposing quadrant negative space.
Sync map arc milestones with subtle tactile ticks and soft camera whooshes.

hook_metrics_00_to_45s.opening_hook_mechanic: High-contrast 2.5D separated historical portrait with giant 3D serif depth title sandwiched behind the subject's silhouette.

layer_composition.background: Inpainted archival background with 3px Gaussian depth-of-field blur scaling 1.06 -> 1.00
layer_composition.midground_animation: Giant 3D gold/crimson depth title placed in rule-of-thirds negative space (>=88% unoccluded) + floating gold embers
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: u2netp + Guided Filter subject cutout scaling counter-directionally 1.00 -> 1.14

timeline_breakdown.camera_motion: Counter-directional dolly-zoom parallax (BG pulls out while FG pushes in)

layer_composition.background: Full-bleed chiaroscuro archival painting with 35mm film grain (14%) and vignette (35%)
layer_composition.midground_animation: Warm anamorphic bokeh orbs drifting across shadow edges
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Clean frame (depth title suppressed on Shot 1+ to prevent repetition)

audio_sync.music_state: Continuous tension bed (-28 dB under voice)

reproducible_style_rules: Always open every scene on its strongest hero 2.5D plate, never weak generic stock B-roll.
Apply 3px Gaussian DOF blur to separated backgrounds and counter-directional scale (FG 1.00->1.14 vs BG 1.06->1.00).
Fire 3D Depth Title strictly on Shot 0 of a scene and enforce >=88% unoccluded legibility via foreground alpha mask analysis.

benchmarks.channel_style: Fern - Dark Minimalist 3D Spatial Reconstructions & Silhouettes

hook_metrics_00_to_45s.opening_hook_mechanic: Stark #121417 obsidian 3D wireframe environment illuminated by volumetric spotlight cones over backlit silhouettes.

layer_composition.background: Slate void #121417 with perspective-projected 3D architectural floor grid and columns
layer_composition.midground_animation: Volumetric spotlight cones sweeping over backlit dark human silhouette
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Glowing tactical target circles (#D9381E, #EAB308, #38BDF8) and minimal forensic telemetry callouts

timeline_breakdown.camera_motion: Smooth orbiting 3D virtual camera matrix with slow elevation tilt

audio_sync.music_state: Sparse sub-drone + hollow room tone (-26 dB)

reproducible_style_rules: Use Dark 3D Reconstructions to explain abstract power structures, imperial decrees, or contested historical spaces without anachronistic footage.
Keep void palette strictly constrained to #121417 slate, #F8FAFC crisp lines, and #D9381E/#EAB308/#38BDF8 focal rings.
Pair spotlight sweeps with subtle atmospheric room tone and low sub pulses.

benchmarks.channel_style: Fern / Elementar - Digital Forensic UI & 240s Pattern Interrupts

hook_metrics_00_to_45s.opening_hook_mechanic: Abrupt music drop into dead silence + mechanical shutter strike resetting viewer attention every 240 seconds.

layer_composition.background: Instant hard cut to dark slate #121417 archival dossier reset frame
layer_composition.midground_animation: Crisp reticle lock-on + chronological chapter stamp
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Bold Courier Prime year stamp with gold accent underline

audio_sync.music_state: Hard mute to absolute silence for 1.25s (Pattern Interrupt @ 240s / 480s / 720s)

layer_composition.background: Dark cork/slate forensic string board over dimmed archival texture
layer_composition.midground_animation: 4 era-matched historical hero plates connected pin-to-pin with catenary red strings completing within first 35% of shot
layer_composition.foreground_overlay: Forensic exhibit badges clear of string paths

timeline_breakdown.camera_motion: Slow investigative drift across connected evidence nodes

audio_sync.music_state: New movement enters cleanly at -28 dB under resumed narration

reproducible_style_rules: Trigger a 1.25s hard music mute + mechanical camera-shutter/typewriter strike every 240 seconds (240s, 480s, 720s) to shatter mid-video fatigue.
Populate forensic string boards and timelines exclusively with era-matched hero plates from the corresponding historical scenes.
Complete all red catenary pin-to-pin animations within the first 35% of the graphic window so no strings hang severed mid-air.
